    # Convert the input number to a string to easily check all digits
    n_str = str(n)
    
    # Check if all digits in the number are the same
    if all(digit == n_str[0] for digit in n_str):
        return n
    
    # Find the smallest number with all digits the same that is greater than n
    for length in range(len(n_str), 4):  # We only need to check up to 3 digits
        for digit in range(10):
            candidate = int(str(digit) * length)
            if candidate >= n:
                return candidate
    
    # If no such number found within constraints (which shouldn't happen given constraints)
